notes.title: Games From Ontario Steam Event
notes.notes:
[h3][b]We're excited to be a part of the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/42151261-Ontario-Creates/sale/gamesfromontario2022]Games from Ontario[/url] Steam event! [/b][/h3]

Starting today, celebrate Ontario game development with a full week of livestreams and discounts! There's over 200 games participating in the event including our upcoming game [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1357430/Rocket_Rumble/]Rocket Rumble[/url]! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35307218/a6ca85468d664b5309e12152ae1b155763747008.png[/img]

PixelNAUTS Games is proud to be Canadian and we feel super lucky that there's such an amazing game development community in our home province! So kick back and enjoy a week of Ontario-made games! 


-PixelNAUTS Games
